description: Use this when someone asks how many units to order, given demand, lead time, stock on hand and on order, and supplier rules such as MOQ, case pack or a minimum order value. Sizes the line the way Forthcast sizes a purchase-order line and lists every rule that changed the quantity. Works without a connected store.

average_daily_demand.description: Average units sold per day, if no daily history.
average_daily_demand.title: Average Daily Demand

case_pack.description: Units per case; quantity is rounded up to whole cases.
case_pack.title: Case Pack

cover_days_target.description: Optional explicit days of cover to buy instead of the default weeks-of-supply target.
cover_days_target.title: Cover Days Target

daily_demand.description: Daily units sold, oldest first, 14 to 365 values.
daily_demand.title: Daily Demand

demand_std_daily.description: Standard deviation of daily demand, if known.
demand_std_daily.title: Demand Std Daily

min_order_value.description: Supplier minimum order value in currency; needs unit_cost.
min_order_value.title: Min Order Value

moq.description: Supplier minimum order quantity for this item.
moq.title: Moq

on_order.description: Units already on open purchase orders.
on_order.title: On Order
